supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41 UTC, WS-ZADAMS-01 accepted a network logon for ian.doyle from 10.55.10.23, the inventory-listed IT administrator workstation WS-IDOYLE-01; the logon received special privileges.

At 13:42 UTC, PowerShell ran as ian.doyle on WS-ZADAMS-01 with the command to execute \\FILE-SUN-01\IT\Patch-Workstations.ps1. The inventory identifies this as the IT administrator's workstation-patching practice, and the change calendar schedules workstation patching during business hours.
The PowerShell process ran for about seven seconds and launched wusa to install a Windows update package; the proxy log also records a Windows Update download during that execution.
The observed PowerShell activity is consistent with the reported brief window and the documented, scheduled patching activity, so the available evidence supports a benign disposition for this alert.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show the PowerShell command line and related process/network activity, but do not include the contents or integrity verification of Patch-Workstations.ps1.
The logs do not establish exactly what Zoe saw on screen or whether the brief window was visible interactively.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not independently prove who was operating WS-IDOYLE-01 or using ian.doyle's credentials at that moment.
The evidence does not establish whether the update installation completed successfully.
unrelated_findings: WS-ZADAMS-01 ran the inventory-unlisted Meridian OpsAgent as SYSTEM; that process then attempted explicit authentication as svc-ledger. Investigate separately, particularly given the scheduled svc-ledger password rotation. These records do not show that this activity caused the alerted PowerShell execution. (T244-00227, T244-00228, T244-00235, T244-00236, T244-00237)

WS-ZADAMS-01 made a proxy CONNECT to updates.paloaltonetworks.com with a GlobalProtect user agent. This is worth separate review against the no-VPN context, but the record alone does not establish a VPN connection or link it to the alerted activity. (T244-00006)
